title: Chitti Car Doctor — Digital Vehicle Twin (per-vehicle)
description: COSDF v1.0 Level 9 per-vehicle schema, adapted to the SAHAYAI_MASTER.md §2b contract: on-device (IndexedDB chitti_4w_twin), user-owned, anonymised aggregates only, wiped by 'Chitti forget'. World Class Chitti Car Doctor — Commando Discipline. Zero Excuses.
$comment: STORAGE: IndexedDB database 'chitti_4w_twin', object store 'vehicles', keyed by vehicle_id. Nothing here leaves the device except the anonymised {predicted, actual, cost_band} tuple via the mechanic verification loop. No plate / identity / GPS in any aggregate. 'Chitti forget' wipes the record and tombstones aggregates (§2b). Mirrors CarProfile in backend/routes/wheels.py.

vehicle_id.description: Local random UUID. NOT the registration plate. Plate is never stored in the twin (§2b).

type.description: ev_4w gates HV-safety guardrails (DO NOT TOUCH orange HV cables) — see guardrails/safety-rules.md.

fuel.description: Drives diesel-specific DPF/EGR/turbo priors, CNG checks, and the hallucination guard (an EV has no engine oil / spark plugs — see evals/hallucination_eval.md).

transmission.description: MT/AT/CVT/AMT/DCT. Drives transmission-fault priors (e.g. AMT shift judder vs CVT belt whine).

last_service.description: Most recent service markers; full history lives append-only in the Vehicle Health Passport.

component_status.description: 0-100 health per component. Drives predictive alerts (F9) and primes the swarm as prior evidence.

battery.$comment: 12V starter battery; EV HV pack tracked separately in ev_health.

ev_health.description: EV-only (type=ev_4w / fuel=ev). On-device range/SoH trend. HV cells are NEVER a DIY surface (guardrails/safety-rules.md).

soh_pct.description: Estimated state-of-health from charge-cycle + range trend.

range_trend.description: A winter/AC-load dip is NORMAL — not pack failure (see evals/diagnostic_accuracy.md).

maintenance_history.description: Pointer-mirror of Passport events of type 'service'. Source of truth = chitti_4w_passport (append-only).

repair_history.description: Pointer-mirror of Passport events of type 'repair'. Each carries a fair-price band check.

fault_history.description: Every diagnosis Chitti gave + the verified outcome from the mechanic verification loop.

dtc_code.description: OBD2 P-code if a scanner was used, e.g. P0420. Unknown codes are queried, never invented.

actual_fix.description: Ground truth from the verification loop; null until the driver reports back.

local_climate.description: Derived from pincode -> IMD (monsoon/dust/heat season). Pincode is coarse, not GPS.

usage_profile.description: cab_commercial = higher wear; raises service cadence and brake/tyre weights.

garage.description: Driver's trusted workshop label (free text, local-only). Never stored against a quality verdict (no defamation — scam-shield-rules.md).

language.description: 9 primary live (en,hi,ta,te,bn,mr,gu,kn,ml); wider 26-voice substrate via Voice Factory. Wider COSDF language list = roadmap.

accessibility_mode.description: From the one-time Disability Profile (§7). Drives modality: voice-first / visual-first / icon-first / haptic.

ownership.description: The §2b user-ownership contract, encoded so any reader of a twin record sees the privacy rules.

on_device.description: Twin lives in IndexedDB on the driver's phone.

shareable.description: Driver may export a read-only resale card (Vehicle Trust Score); never auto-uploaded or sold.

forgettable.description: 'Chitti forget' wipes this record and tombstones any anonymised aggregate.

aggregate_leaves.description: The ONLY fields that may leave the device, and only anonymised, via the verification loop.

predicted_window.description: Plain-language Likely/Possible window, e.g. '3-5 months'. NEVER a guaranteed date (never-claim-certainty.md).

passport_event_id.description: Join key into chitti_4w_passport (append-only source of truth).

verified.description: Confirmed via the mechanic verification loop?
